opportunities.title: PostgreSQL Just Patched a Bug Older Than the iPhone — 22 Years, 52 Flaws, One Very Patient RCE
opportunities.why_now: A newly disclosed authenticated RCE in PostgreSQL had been sitting unpatched for 22 years, the kind of patch-cadence failure this channel exists to catalog.
opportunities.angle: Patch-cadence postmortem: timeline of the bug's age vs. disclosure, why nobody found it sooner, action items for DBAs

opportunities.title: Log4Shell Is Five Years Old and Still Getting People Owned — This Time a Russian Code-Signing Server
opportunities.why_now: BO Team used Log4Shell against VMware vCenter to compromise a Russian firm's code-signing infrastructure, proof the 2021 CVE refuses to die.
opportunities.angle: 'Zombie CVE' feature: why Log4Shell keeps working years later and what it says about patch debt in enterprise VMware deployments

opportunities.title: 100,000 Bugs and Counting: 2026's Vulnerability Count Just Hit a Grim Milestone
opportunities.why_now: The year's CVE tally crossing 100K is a hard number that frames the entire 'inevitable breach' thesis of the channel in one headline.
opportunities.angle: Data-driven digest: chart the 100K milestone against prior years, break down by severity/vendor, tease what it means for patch teams heading into 2027

opportunities.title: Binance Got Hit Through a Door It Knew Was Unlocked
opportunities.why_now: Dark Reading reports attackers exploited a known weakness and missing controls at Binance — a textbook 'we saw this coming' breach.
opportunities.angle: Breach autopsy: map the known weakness to the missing control, contrast with industry best-practice checklists exchanges ignore

opportunities.title: Your Hardware Wallet Might Already Be Compromised: Trezor Confirms Supply-Chain Implants
opportunities.why_now: Trezor confirmed hidden hardware implants in wallets sold through a third-party channel, capable of stealing recovery phrases — a physical supply-chain breach story with immediate reader stakes.
opportunities.angle: Explainer + action guide: how the implant works, how to check your device, why 'cold storage' isn't immune to supply-chain compromise
